sentences.en: The notorious rebel was ultimately captured and confined to jail.
sentences.zh: 那个臭名昭著的反叛者最终被捕并被关进了监狱。

sentences.en: We recommend cutting off all further contact with the rebels.
sentences.zh: 我们建议切断与所有反政府人员的一切进一步联系。

sentences.en: Those rogue rebels do not deserve to roam the Earth.
sentences.zh: 那些叛逆分子不配在地球上自由行走。

mnemonic: 词根记忆：re（相反）+bel（战斗）→反过来打自己人→反叛
